pr_title: Visually shorten gemini urls in account bio header fields
pr_body:
This pull request updates the `link_html` method in the `Formatter` to match Gemini urls.

Closes #15990
pr_comments:
> The code change does not change whether gemini URLs get hyperlinked, just how they are shortened visually. Nevertheless, the test shows that gemini URLs already are being hyperlinked, so I suggest a PR title change.

Ack thanks @Gargron :+1: I've updated the title of the pull request.
Um, does it actually make sense to hide the `gemini` protocol visually? It can't really be opened unless you know what Gemini is, and might lead to people clicking on links they can't open.

> Um, does it actually make sense to hide the `gemini` protocol visually? It can't really be opened unless you know what Gemini is, and might lead to people clicking on links they can't open.

Hmm yea I think that's fair. Maybe it's better to leave it as it then.

Thanks for taking a look and raising this point @Gargron

issue_context.title: Gemini urls in account header fields
issue_context.body:
### Pitch

In closing #14991 gemini urls in posts were converted to hyperlinks. Yea in the account bio header fields, a gemini url remains as plaintext.

### Motivation

Consistency of converting gemini urls into hyperlinks in the same places throughout mastodon that http urls are converted to hyperlinks.
comments: Closing as it probably makes sense to leave the `gemini` protocol visible. See [this comment](https://github.com/tootsuite/mastodon/pull/15991#issuecomment-817805773) on the pull request.

review_comments: This doesn't control what gets hyperlinked, just how URLs get visually shortened
